## Research focus

Theory, simulation, and data-driven inference for complex molecular systems.
:::

::: {.focus-grid}
::: {.focus-card}
### [Interfacial electrochemistry](projects/reaction-field-toolkit.qmd)

Understanding electric fields, solvent structure, and double-layer behavior at solid–liquid interfaces.
:::

::: {.focus-card}
### [Molecular simulation](publications.qmd)

Connecting atomistic trajectories to physical models across liquids, polymers, peptides, and nanomaterials.
:::

::: {.focus-card}
### [Data-driven inference](projects/madelung-denoising.qmd)

Building Bayesian and machine-learning methods that recover interpretable signals from noisy molecular data.
